verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents an API that returns ThumbnailSet resources for a DriveItem, and claims rich thumbnails for hundreds of formats. That covers the thumbnail half of the story with server-side rendering. The evidence never mentions an embeddable document preview endpoint or iframe-able viewer. Missing for 10: documented embeddable document preview API, format coverage details for thumbnails, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, previews are an API call — thumbnails and embeddable document previews served for common formats without me rendering them

citations.quote: Retrieve a collection of ThumbnailSet resources for a DriveItem resource.
Files light up with rich thumbnails for hundreds of formats, video streaming, analytics, and more, powered by Microsoft Graph.
